26:85.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

26:86.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

26:87.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are

26:88.text: The Day when there will not benefit

26:89.text: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

26:90.text: And Paradise will be brought near

26:91.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

26:92.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

26:93.text: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

26:94.text: So they will be overturned into it

26:95.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

26:96.text: They will say while they dispute therein,

26:97.text: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

26:98.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

26:99.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

26:100.text: So now we have no intercessors

26:102.text: Then if we only had a return
and could be of the believers..."

26:103.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

26:104.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

26:105.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers

26:106.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

26:107.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

26:108.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:109.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

26:110.text: So fear Allāh and obey me."
